verdict.rationale: INPI's public site has instruction and guidance pages for filing trademarks, designs, patents, e-Soleau and utility certificates, plus examination guidelines, so the instructional half of the story is publicly reachable. Nothing shows the filing forms themselves are downloadable, and "dépôt en ligne" suggests filing happens through an online service. The data.inpi.fr 403 probe concerns the open-data API, not forms, so it does not bear on this story. Missing for 10: evidence of downloadable forms (e.g. PDF/Cerfa), explicit confirmation that no account is needed, hands-on corroboration of download access.
